def factor_volume_price_spearman_corr_vol_scaled(df):
    """Rolling Spearman correlation between price returns and volume changes, scaled by inverse return volatility."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    vol_chg = df_copy["volume"].pct_change()
    ret_rank = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=5).rank(pct=True)
    vol_rank = vol_chg.rolling(20, min_periods=5).rank(pct=True)
    corr = ret_rank.rolling(20, min_periods=5).corr(vol_rank)
    vol_std = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=5).std()
    scale = 1.0 / (1.0 + vol_std)
    factor = corr * scale
    factor = factor.fillna(0.0)
    factor.name = "factor_volume_price_spearman_corr_vol_scaled"
    return factor
